title: Kiln model recipe
description: One runnable model: every file it needs from Hugging Face and the settings that make it work. This schema describes the curated recipes in recipes/. It is stricter than the app in three ways: every file must be pinned (revision, size_bytes, sha256), engine must be sd.cpp, and unknown fields are rejected (the app ignores them). Reference: docs/recipes.md. Create and check recipes with scripts/recipe.py.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, so editors can validate and autocomplete the file. Use "./schema.json". The app ignores it.

id.description: Unique identifier and file name: the recipe is saved as recipes/<id>.json. Lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only; it cannot start with a dot.

name.description: Display name shown in the app, for example "Stable Diffusion XL Base 1.0". Cannot be empty or blank.

engine.description: Inference engine. The only engine Kiln includes is "sd.cpp" (stable-diffusion.cpp), and curated recipes must use it.

components.description: Files every install of the model needs, one per role. With "variants", these are the files shared by all variants and the list may be empty; without variants it needs at least one entry.

license_note.description: Short, accurate summary of the licence of every file, including restrictions such as non-commercial use. When components have different licences, name each one.

min_memory_gb.description: Smallest amount of system RAM, in GB, the recipe is expected to run on. On a Mac with less, the recipe is labelled too large whatever its file sizes. A variant's own value takes precedence.

tested.description: True once someone has run this recipe in Kiln and it generated an image. Leave it out otherwise; the app labels the recipe as untested.

base_model.description: Hugging Face repo of the original model the diffusion_model file was made from, for example "black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev" for a GGUF conversion of it. It must be what the file's own repo states in its base_model tag. The app uses it to run files from other repos of the same model with this recipe's other files and settings. Only for recipes with a diffusion_model component.

variants.description: Alternative sets of files for the same model, usually different quantizations. Each variant's components are merged over the shared "components": a file with the same role replaces the shared one. Every variant must add up to a complete model.

component.description: One file in a Hugging Face repo.

role.description: What the engine loads the file as. checkpoint: a single file that carries everything (SD 1.x, SDXL). diffusion_model: a standalone denoiser. llm: a language model used as the text encoder (Qwen-Image and similar). vae: a standalone VAE. clip_l, clip_g, t5xxl: CLIP and T5 text encoders (Flux and SD3 families). Each role may appear once in a list.

repo.description: Hugging Face repo id in the form owner/name, for example "stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0".

file.description: Path of the file inside the repo, for example "vae/model.safetensors". No leading slash, no backslash, and no empty, "." or ".." segment.

revision.description: Full commit sha of the repo to download from, so the download is reproducible. scripts/recipe.py fills this in. (The app falls back to "main" when it is absent, but curated recipes must pin it.)

size_bytes.description: Exact size of the file in bytes. Checked after download and used for the disk-space check, progress and the memory-fit estimate. scripts/recipe.py fills this in.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file as 64 hexadecimal characters. Checked after download. scripts/recipe.py fills this in from the Hugging Face API.

defaults.description: Recommended generation settings. Take every value from the model card or from stable-diffusion.cpp's documentation for the model; do not guess.

cfg.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Cannot be negative. Distilled models commonly use 1.0.

sampler.description: Sampling method by its stable-diffusion.cpp name. An unknown name fails at generation time.

width.description: Image width in pixels. Greater than zero.

height.description: Image height in pixels. Greater than zero.

sigmas.description: Explicit noise schedule. Must contain exactly steps + 1 values. Used only while the user keeps the recipe's step count.

flash_attention.description: Enables flash attention for the diffusion model when the model is loaded. Treated as false when absent.

scheduler.description: Noise scheduler by its stable-diffusion.cpp name. When absent, the engine's default for the model and sampler is used. An unknown name fails at generation time.

guidance.description: Distilled guidance, used by guidance-distilled models such as Flux. The engine's default when absent.

flow_shift.description: Flow shift for flow-matching models. The model's own default when absent.

variant.description: One way to install the model: the files that differ from the shared components, typically a quantization of the large parts.

id.description: Identifier of the variant, unique within the recipe, for example "q8". Lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only; it cannot start with a dot.

name.description: Name shown in the app, for example "Q8 (best quality)". Cannot be empty or blank.

components.description: Files for this variant, at least one. A file with the same role as a shared component replaces it; the others are added.

min_memory_gb.description: Smallest amount of system RAM, in GB, this variant is expected to run on. Falls back to the recipe's min_memory_gb when absent.
